symptom: A tab page Badge set in Studio Pro (Forms$TabPage.Badge, a Forms$ClientTemplate) was removed by any MDL rewrite of its page: `check` warned MDL-WIDGET07 "property `Badge` is not recognized and will be silently dropped on write — did you mean `Image`?", describe printed `tabpage tpOne (Caption: 'One') {`, and executing that output answered "Replaced page" with "Badge": null; mx check clean throughout (Mendix 11.12.5)
cause: MDL had no spelling for the badge: pages.TabPage had no field, buildTabPageV3 read only caption, visibility and children, the writer never set Badge, and describe's tab page parse did not read it. The visitor already parsed `Badge: '…'` as a string and `BadgeParams: (…)` through the generic <Name>Params path
file: mdl/executor/tabpage_badge.go (reads, emits, MDL-WIDGET51); cmd_pages_builder_v3_layout.go (buildTabPageV3); validate_widgets.go (per-type MDL-WIDGET07 exemption); cmd_pages_describe_parse.go / cmd_pages_describe_output.go; sdk/pages TabPage.Badge; mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (SetBadge via clientTemplateToGen)
fix: `Badge: '{1}', BadgeParams: ({1} = Attribute)` on a tab page, the dynamic text's Content/ContentParams shape, built with buildClientTemplateParams against the enclosing data container and written as Forms$TabPage.Badge; describe prints it, including an empty template, so the round trip keeps it. The keys are exempted from MDL-WIDGET07 for tabpage only (isTabPageBadgeProp), not added to the cross-widget union; BadgeParams without Badge or a non-string Badge is refused at check and exec (MDL-WIDGET51)
insight: The real data was already in a fixture: ako/TestApp (11.14.0) stores Studio Pro badges on WorkflowCommons.TaskInbox (3 tab pages) and TaskDashboard (4), `{1}` bound to a helper's MyOpenTaskCount / AllOpenTaskCount / UnassignedTaskCount — scan the fixtures for the property before building a seed. Describe → exec now keeps all 7 identical (ids aside); the pre-fix binary nulls all 3 on TaskInbox. Check what the visitor already produces before touching the grammar: both keys arrived parsed, so the gap was builder, writer and describe only. Keep a per-type key out of staticWidgetKnownProps and in its own file (the input_submit_width.go arrangement): the union would have silenced MDL-WIDGET07 for `Badge:` on every other widget, and TestStaticWidgetKnownProps_CoverSourceVocabulary scans the builder and describe-output files for keys. The version facts are in modelsdk/gen/pages/version.go (Forms$TabPage badge Introduced 8.13.0, below every supported version), so no gate. Wrong turn to skip: on the 11.6.6 fixture the report's `layoutgrid … column (DesktopWidth: AutoFill)` wrapper fails mx check with CE0535 with or without a badge — drop the grid to test the badge. ALTER PAGE … SET (Badge: …) is refused (property not found), not supported yet
